'''Bhutanese Sign Language''' ('''BhSL'''; {{Transliteration|dz|Drukgi Lagdai Khakay}} in [[Dzongkha]]{{native script needed}}) is the indigenous sign language of [[Bhutan]], used especially at the Wangsel Institute for the Deaf, [[Paro, Bhutan]].

Bhutan set up the program for the deaf in a hearing school in [[Thimphu]] ca. 2000, and the first dedicated school, in [[Paro, Bhutan|Paro]], was approved in 2013.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Gallaudet Alumna Helps Set Course for Deaf Education in Bhutan |url=http://www.gallaudet.edu/news/bhutan_.html |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150219053000/http://www.gallaudet.edu/news/bhutan_.html |archive-date=2015-02-19 |access-date=2015-02-19 |website=Gallaudet University}}</ref>  Part of government funding for deaf education includes developing '''Bhutanese Sign Language''' as the language of instruction.  Development includes at least creating vocabulary for technical subjects,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Consultancy: Research, Bhutanese Sign Language |url=http://georgem.co.tz/showthread.php?t=938 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150425123210/http://georgem.co.tz/showthread.php?t=938 |archive-date=2015-04-25 |access-date=2015-02-19 |website=Georgem}}</ref> and deciding on which regional signs to use where they differ.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 May 2003 |title=Bhutan to Begin Deaf Education |url=http://www.deaftoday.com/news/archives/2003/05/bhutan_to_begin.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150219054307/http://www.deaftoday.com/news/archives/2003/05/bhutan_to_begin.html |archive-date=2015-02-19 |access-date=2015-02-19 |website=Deaf Today}}</ref>

It is not clear if there are multiple sign languages in Bhutan, or merely local differences in vocabulary.  It is unknown whether Bhutanese Sign Language is related to [[Indian Sign Language]] or [[Nepali Sign Language]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2012 |title=The Deaf Community of India |url=http://joshuaproject.net/profiles/text/t19007_in.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150219052611/http://joshuaproject.net/profiles/text/t19007_in.pdf |archive-date=2015-02-19 |access-date=2015-02-19 |via=Joshua Project}}</ref>
